column1: # Hand-picked real-world corpus from GitHub: source files that carry business logic in popular, unarchived
# repositories. Excluded: tests, examples, demos, documentation, third-party code vendored into a repository
# (such as the Bootstrap 2 copy inside publify), malware source collections (vxunderground/MalwareSourceCode),
# iTerm2 was on the list originally, but its sources/ moved into deeply nested subdirectories; FLEX, another
# The files belong to their repositories and stay under those repositories' licenses. They are not
# copied into this repository or the published package: `scripts/fetch-github-corpus.mjs` downloads them to
# a local directory, and the evidence harnesses only read them to compute aggregate numbers.
# Each file is pinned to a commit so that re-running the measurements reads the same bytes.
